89	noncomputable section
90	
91	/-! ## The Abel chart's value, both components -/
92	
93	/-- **The Abel chart map evaluated at a point of the divisor scheme.**
94	
95	`abelSigmaChart` is `rep.toSigmaExtension ≫ Over.sigmaExtensionNat (chartValueTrans …)`, and
96	both factors act componentwise on the Σ-extension, so the value at `x : Y ⟶ D.left` is the
97	pair whose structure morphism is `x ≫ D.hom` and whose class is the chart value of the divisor
98	family `rep.homEquiv (Over.homMk x rfl)`.
99	
100	Recorded as an equation because a coverage producer has to match this against a *given*
101	section, and the match is two equations rather than one: the Σ-components must agree before
102	the classes are even in the same type.  Leaving it to unfold at the use site is how the
103	Σ-component gets forgotten. -/
104	@[simp]
105	theorem abelChartApp_eq {D : Over (Spec (.of k))} (rep : (divFunctor C π n).RepresentableBy D)
106	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
107	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
108	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
109	    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (x : Y ⟶ D.left) :
110	    (abelSigmaChart C π n rep m Z hdeg).app (op Y) x
111	      = ⟨x ≫ D.hom, ⟨chartValue C π n m Z (Over.mk (x ≫ D.hom))
112	          (rep.homEquiv (Over.homMk x rfl)),
113	        chartValue_mem_pic0Subgroup C π n m Z hdeg _ _⟩⟩ :=
114	  rfl
115	
116	/-! ## The `haff` residue, named
117	
118	`chartLocusOpens` takes the affine-local openness as an argument.  Naming it is not cosmetic:
119	an argument in a definition's signature is invisible to a census of open obligations, which is
120	how "the `W` field costs zero" survived into two roadmap rows. -/
121	
122	variable (C) in
123	/-- **The affine-local openness residue of `chartLocus`** — what `chartLocusOpens` costs.
124	
125	For a test `T` and a class `lam` on it, this says the chart locus is open over every affine
126	open piece of `T`.  It is exactly the `haff` argument of `isOpen_chartLocus_of_affineLocal'`,
127	and it is the *only* remaining input to CHART-U(b) at a general test: the iso-invariance
128	hypothesis that used to sit beside it was discharged
129	(`isSplitWitnessIsoInvariant_holds`), but this one was passed through, not proved.
130	
131	Named as a `Prop` so that it appears in searches for open obligations. -/
132	def ChartLocusAffineLocal (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
133	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (lam : picEt C T) : Prop :=
134	  ∀ U : T.left.affineOpens,
135	    IsOpen (chartLocus C m Z (picEtMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) lam))
136	
137	variable (C) in
138	/-- `chartLocusOpens` with its cost made explicit in the API.
139	
140	Identical in content to `chartLocusOpens` — the point is that the dependency is now a named
141	`Prop` a reader can grep for, rather than an unnamed argument that reads as bookkeeping. -/
142	def chartLocusOpens' (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
143	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (lam : picEt C T)
144	    (haff : ChartLocusAffineLocal C m Z T lam) : T.left.Opens :=
145	  chartLocusOpens C m Z T lam haff
146	
147	@[simp]
148	lemma mem_chartLocusOpens' {m : ℕ} {Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor}
149	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {lam : picEt C T} {haff : ChartLocusAffineLocal C m Z T lam}
150	    {t : T.left} :
151	    t ∈ chartLocusOpens' C m Z T lam haff ↔ t ∈ chartLocus C m Z lam :=
152	  Iff.rfl
153	
154	/-! ## Reducing the residue to B-4's own named obligation
155	
156	`Pic0ChartLocusIsOpen.lean:321`'s docstring says the general-test statement follows from the
157	affine one "by the affine-piece locality of the (b-amendment)'s transport (iii)", and adds that
158	it "is not stated here only because it would need the presentation hypothesis *per affine
159	piece*".  That is right, and this is the statement it describes. -/
160	
161	set_option linter.overlappingInstances false in
162	variable (C π) in
163	/-- **The `haff` residue from a per-affine-piece presentation** — the link
164	`Pic0ChartLocusIsOpen`'s docstring describes and does not state.
165	
166	For each affine open `U` of the test, a `BasicOpenCocycleDatum` over `Γ(T.left, U)` presenting
167	the restricted twisted class gives openness of the locus on that piece
168	(`isOpen_setOf_isSplitWitness_of_presentation`), and `chartLocus` over the piece *is* that set
169	by definition (`chartLocus` unfolds to the split-witness set of the twisted class, and the
170	twist commutes with restriction by `picEtMap_chartTwist`).
171	
172	So the affine-local residue is **exactly** B-4's presentation obligation, quantified over
173	affine pieces — no extra geometry, and in particular nothing certificate- or divRep-gated.
174	Combined with `isOpen_chartLocus_of_affineLocal'` this closes CHART-U(b) at a general test the
175	moment `IsChartDatumPresentation` is available per piece.
176	
177	The `hπ` and `IsFinite π` hypotheses are the ones
178	`isOpen_setOf_isSplitWitness_of_presentation` carries.  `IsFinite π` is strictly stronger than
179	the file-level `IsAffineHom π` (whence the overlapping-instance warning, disabled below): the
180	affine openness route runs through the rigid engine, which needs finiteness, while the rest of
181	this file needs only affineness. -/
182	theorem chartLocusAffineLocal_of_presentation [IsFinite π]
183	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
184	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
185	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (lam : picEt C T)
186	    (hpres : ∀ U : T.left.affineOpens,
187	      ∃ D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C (Γ(T.left, U.1)) π,
188	        IsChartDatumPresentation C π
189	          (chartTwist C m Z _ (picEtMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) lam)) D) :
190	    ChartLocusAffineLocal C m Z T lam := by
191	  intro U
192	  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := hpres U
193	  exact isOpen_setOf_isSplitWitness_of_presentation C π hπ hD
194	
195	end
196	
197	end AlgebraicGeometry

8	
9	/-!
10	# COVERAGE NEEDS NO DROP, NO ORACLE, AND NO STEP 6
11	
12	A retraction of this lane's own account of B-5, and it removes a residue rather than adding one.
13	
14	`Picard/Pic0ChartCoverageTest.lean`'s DEFECT section establishes — correctly — that the
15	`w4-datb` §1.2 argument as written runs the greedy drop at `Z := 0` and feeds the drop's
16	**output** `Σ` back as the chart index's `Z`, so that the two stages carry different `Z`, and
17	that this feedback ("step 6") is not discharged anywhere.  It records step 6 as one of B-5's
18	open residues.
19	
20	**Step 6 is not a residue, because coverage does not need the drop at all.**
21	
22	## Why: read what `chartLocus` actually asks for
23	
24	`IsSplitWitness` (`Pic0ChartLocus.lean:151`) — and its own docstring says this at length, under
25	"A convention this predicate INHERITS" — asks for a divisor `W` in the presenting class with
26	`Subsingleton H¹(𝒪(W))`, and asks for **neither `0 ≤ W` nor `deg W = g`**.  Effectivity and the
27	degree normalisation are what the *chart map's injectivity* needs (GAP-2, `h⁰ = 1`), not what
28	*membership of the locus* needs.
29	
30	The drop (`RiemannRoch/CoverageDrop.lean`) exists to manufacture exactly those two extra
31	properties: it takes a degree-`g+e` witness with `h¹ = 0` and produces an effective `S` with
32	`h⁰(W₀ − S) = 1`.  For membership, that work is thrown away — `mem_chartLocus_of_drop` returns
33	the `IsSplitWitness` half from `hW₀`/`h1` alone, and its own proof shows this: the split witness
34	comes from `isSplitWitness_of_witness_twistClass C μ m Z M₀ hM₀ W₀ hW₀ h1`, in which the drop,
35	the oracle `P`, `hdense`, `hPcl`, `hPdeg`, `g`, `e`, `hχ` and `hdeg` **do not appear**.
36	
37	So the feedback of step 6 was an artefact of routing coverage through the drop.  Cut the drop
38	and there is one `Z` again — the chart index's — and nothing to feed back.
39	
40	## What coverage then needs, in full
41	
42	Exactly one input beyond the landed splitting: a divisor of the twisted fibre class over the
43	splitting field with vanishing `H¹`.  That is DAT-0a at the fibre field, and it is genuinely
44	per-fibre (I-0204, `w4-datb` §0.2.2): no uniform `m₀` exists, so the exponent `m` must be chosen
45	against `L`'s own threshold `b_L`.
46	
47	**RETRACTED 2026-07-29 (I-0660).**  This paragraph continued: `mem_chartLocus_of_vanishing_bound`
48	"takes `b_L` in exactly the shape `exists_bound_subsingleton_hModule_one_of_isFinite_toP1`
49	produces it, and *derives* the `m` — so what remains of step 3 is instantiating DAT-0a at the
50	base-changed curve, not choosing anything."  That is FALSE.  At a chart index legal at parameter
51	`n` the `hdeg` hypothesis **forces `b = n`**, and at `n = g` the resulting `hb` is a statement
52	that is false in general — see the retraction note on
53	`mem_chartLocus_of_vanishing_bound` itself and `Picard/Pic0ChartCoverageIndexSlack.lean` for the
54	three machine-checked statements that replace it.  The theorem below is sound; only this account
55	of what remains was wrong.
56	
57	## Main declarations
58	
59	* `AlgebraicGeometry.mem_chartLocus_of_witness_h1` — **coverage, drop-free**: a splitting plus a
60	  vanishing witness in the twisted class gives `t ∈ chartLocus`.  No `g`, no `e`, no `χ`, no
61	  oracle, no effectivity.
62	* `AlgebraicGeometry.mem_chartLocus_of_vanishing_bound` — the same with the witness *produced*
63	  from a degree threshold at the splitting field.  Sound; but read its retraction note before
64	  reading the threshold as DAT-0a's (it is forced to equal the chart parameter, I-0660).
65	* `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_mem_chartLocus_of_vanishing_bound` — the `∃ m` form: the coverage
66	  statement `w4-datb` §1.2 targets, at a fixed chart-index shape.
67	-/

82	open AlgebraicJacobian

84	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
85	
86	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
87	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
88	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
89	
90	noncomputable section
91	
92	/-! ## Coverage without the drop -/
93	
94	variable (C) in
95	/-- **COVERAGE, DROP-FREE** — `w4-datb` §1.2 with steps 4, 5 and 6 deleted rather than
96	discharged.
97	
98	For a point `t` of an arbitrary test `T` and a plus class `lam`: given a finite separable
99	`L/κ(t)` presenting the fibre class by `M₀`, and **any** divisor `W` of the twisted class over
100	`L` with `Subsingleton H¹(𝒪(W))`, the point `t` lies in `chartLocus C m Z lam`.
101	
102	Compare `mem_chartLocus_of_drop`, whose membership half this strictly generalises: that theorem
103	additionally takes `g`, `e`, `hχ`, `hdeg` and a four-part point oracle, and uses none of them
104	for the membership conclusion.  Dropping them is what removes step 6's feedback — the drop's
105	output `Σ` was the only reason two different `Z`s were in play. -/
106	theorem mem_chartLocus_of_witness_h1 {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : picEt C T) (t : T.left)
107	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
108	    {L : Type u} [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra (Over.testPointField t) L]
109	    [IsScalarTower k (Over.testPointField t) L]
110	    [Module.Finite (Over.testPointField t) L]
111	    [Algebra.IsSeparable (Over.testPointField t) L]
112	    (M₀ : (relCurve C L).CechPic)
113	    (hM₀ : PicEtAff.map C L
114	        (picEtAffineEquiv C (Over.testPointField t) (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) lam))
115	      = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M₀))
116	    (W : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor)
117	    (hW : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W
118	      = M₀ * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) (chartTwistClass C m Z))
119	    (h1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) 1)) :
120	    t ∈ chartLocus C m Z lam :=
121	  mem_chartLocus_of_isSplitWitness_fibre C m Z lam t
122	    (isSplitWitness_of_witness_twistClass C (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) lam) m Z M₀ hM₀
123	      W hW h1)
124	
125	/-! ## Producing the witness from a degree threshold -/
126	
127	variable (C) in
128	/-- **Coverage from a vanishing threshold at the splitting field.**  The theorem is TRUE and
129	correctly proved; the paragraph that described `hb` as "DAT-0a's threshold, so the twist exponent
130	is *derived*" was WRONG and is retracted below.
131	
132	`hb`: every divisor of degree `≥ b` on `C_L` has vanishing `H¹`.  `hdeg`: the twisted presenting
133	class has `classDeg = b`, which `classDeg_presenting_twist`
134	(`Pic0ChartCoverageDegreeStep2.lean`) computes as `m·d₁ − deg_k Z` for a degree-zero `lam`.
135	Every divisor of the class has that degree (`classDeg_picClass`), so the threshold applies to the
136	representative `exists_picClass_eq` produces, and `mem_chartLocus_of_witness_h1` finishes.  No
137	effectivity is needed anywhere, which is why no drop appears.
138	
139	**RETRACTED 2026-07-29 (I-0660; adjudicated in `Picard/Pic0ChartCoverageIndexSlack.lean`).**  The
140	claim that `hdeg` is "*supplied*, not assumed, once the chart index is fixed", i.e. that `b` may
141	be taken to be DAT-0a's bound, is FALSE at the parameter that matters:
142	
143	* at a chart index legal at parameter `n` (`deg_k Z = m·d₁ − n`, which
144	  `chartValue_mem_pic0Subgroup` requires) `hdeg` **forces `b = n`** — it determines `b` rather
145	  than accepting it (`ledger_forces_b_eq_n`);
146	* at `n = g`, `hb` at `b = g` forces **every** degree-`g` divisor to have `h⁰ = 1`
147	  (`hb_forces_h0_eq_one`), which is false on a curve with a moving degree-`g` family.  DAT-0a's
148	  own bound is `n₁·deg F + g` with `0 < deg F`, i.e. strictly above `g` for `n₁ ≥ 1`.
149	
150	What survives: `hdeg` is not unsatisfiable — for any `b ≥ 0` a legal index at parameter `b.toNat`
151	satisfies it by construction (`index_of_threshold`), since `n` is free throughout the chart layer.
152	So this theorem is usable, and the residue of B-5 step 3 is the reconciliation of the chart
153	parameter with the threshold, not an instantiation of DAT-0a. -/
154	theorem mem_chartLocus_of_vanishing_bound {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : picEt C T)
155	    (t : T.left) (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
156	    {L : Type u} [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra (Over.testPointField t) L]
157	    [IsScalarTower k (Over.testPointField t) L]
158	    [Module.Finite (Over.testPointField t) L]
159	    [Algebra.IsSeparable (Over.testPointField t) L]
160	    (M₀ : (relCurve C L).CechPic)
161	    (hM₀ : PicEtAff.map C L
162	        (picEtAffineEquiv C (Over.testPointField t) (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) lam))
163	      = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M₀))
164	    -- The `classDeg L` of `hdeg` is applied to a `relCurve`-spelled class, and the
165	    -- `BaseChangeInstances` pack is keyed to the PRODUCT spelling `(C ⊗ overSpec k L).left`,
166	    -- so these three do not synthesise in the STATEMENT (a `haveI` in the proof is too late).
167	    -- They are not new assumptions: `instIsIntegralBaseChange`,
168	    -- `instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange` and `instQuasiCompactBaseChange` discharge
169	    -- them at every instantiation, and the proof below re-derives the rest of the pack.
170	    [IsIntegral (relCurve C L)]
171	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L))]
172	    [QuasiCompact (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L))]
173	    [Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 0)]
174	    [Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 1)]
175	    (b : ℤ)
176	    (hb : ∀ D : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor,
177	      b ≤ Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L D →
178	        Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L D) 1))
179	    (hdeg : classDeg L (M₀ * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
180	      (chartTwistClass C m Z)) = b) :
181	    t ∈ chartLocus C m Z lam := by
182	  -- The instance pack of `BaseChangeInstances` is keyed to the PRODUCT spelling
183	  -- `(C ⊗ overSpec k L).left`, not to the `relCurve` alias, so the `relCurve`-spelled
184	  -- binders of `exists_picClass_eq` / `classDeg_picClass` do not synthesise without these
185	  -- re-keyings (the same pack `Pic0ChartCoverageFibre.lean:130` needs).  The `hdeg`/`M₀`
186	  -- binders are therefore stated in the PRODUCT spelling, so that the statement itself needs
187	  -- no re-keying — `relCurveMap C k L` is `(C ◁ overSpecMap (ofId k L)).left`
188	  -- (`relCurveMap_eq_overSpecMap_ofId`), which is also the spelling
189	  -- `classDeg_presenting_twist` delivers.
190	  haveI : IsIntegral (relCurve C L) := instIsIntegralBaseChange C L
191	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
192	    instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C L
193	  haveI : QuasiCompact (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
194	    instQuasiCompactBaseChange C L

ONE CORRECTION TO THE TREE, and it is the real first gap of CHART-U(a).
The roadmap chart-u node names three missing inputs (shifted-datum constructor, split
predicate, transports i/ii). There is a FOURTH, prior to all of them, and it is why
nothing in the tree implements chartLocus: there is no way to say "the fibre of a class
at a point t of a general test T" at all. Every witness predicate in the tree is indexed
by PrimeSpectrum B over an AFFINE base; every field point of a general test is modelled
only as a morphism (t : overSpec k K -> T) for an abstract field K. Nothing converts a
point of T.left into such a morphism. chartLocus c lambda is a Set T.left, so that
conversion is the definition's first obligation, not a lemma about it.

I am building it as the affine-chart route: t in T.left lies in some affine open U, giving
q : PrimeSpectrum (Gamma(T.left,U)) and the test map Over.fromSpecAffine
(PicEtUnit.lean:61); the residue field is q.asIdeal.ResidueField. Well-definedness across
the choice of U is then a real lemma, not bookkeeping, and it is the one I am proving
first. Recording it here so nobody budgets CHART-U as three inputs when it is four.

No witness divisor, no `H¹`, no degree: this says only that the plus class obtained by
restricting `μ` to the residue field at `t` is the plus-unit of the datum's fibre class there.

Isolated as a definition because it is what the forward direction of
`IsChartDatumPresentation` actually consumes, and because it is a statement about the *naturality
of `cechPicClass` under base change to residue fields* — checkable independently of anything
about witnesses. -/
def IsChartDatumPlusFibre {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k A)) (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C A π) : Prop :=
  ∀ t : (overSpec k A).left,
    PicEtAff.map C (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)
        (picEtAffineEquiv C (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)
          (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) μ))
      = PicEtAff.unit C (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)
          (relPicMk C (overSpec k (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t))
            (Scheme.CechPic.map
              (relCurveMap C A (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t))
              D.cechPicClass))

/-! ## The forward half -/

variable (C π) in
/-- **The forward half of `IsChartDatumPresentation`, pointwise.**

If the datum presents `μ` at `κ(t)` as plus classes (`IsChartDatumPlusFibre`, which mentions no
witness), then the datum's fibre predicate at `κ(t)` implies the split predicate for `μ`'s fibre.

The proof is the **trivial splitting**: take `L := κ(t)`, the identity extension.  The witness
divisor the datum predicate hands over already lies in the right class and already has vanishing
`H¹`, so nothing has to be transported.  `isSplitWitness_of_presenting_witness_self` is the
instance of the introduction rule this needs, and it is the instance memory I-0564 recorded as
unelaborable — see its docstring in `Picard/Pic0ChartTwistSplit.lean` for why staging the
existentials makes it a one-liner.

Note what this does *not* need: no separability argument, no common refinement, no descent.  All
of that belongs to the converse. -/
theorem isSplitWitness_of_hasWitnessH1Vanishing {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    {μ : picEt C (overSpec k A)} {D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C A π}
    (hfib : IsChartDatumPlusFibre C π μ D) (t : (overSpec k A).left)
    (h : D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing (Over.testPointField (T := overSpec k A) t)) :
    IsSplitWitness C (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) μ) := by

owes only `hfib`.

**What this settles about the CHART-U(b) row.**  The row's state as of 2026-07-29 was "both
halves of the pointwise presentation are witness-free, and what remains is a `cechPicClass`
base-change identity at every extension of `κ(t)`, strictly more than `IsChartDatumPlusFibre`
asks".  That gap is now closed in the *cheap* direction the row did not expect: the extra
strength is not extra content, because the identity at `L` is the identity at `κ(t)` pushed
along `PicEtAff.map`.  `isChartDatumPlusFibreAt_self` measured the gap from below (at
`L := κ(t)` the two coincide by `Iff.rfl`); this measures it from above, and the two together say
the generalisation in `L` costs nothing.

So `IsChartDatumPresentation` — B-4's named residue, CHART-U(b)'s one remaining obligation, and
the thing `ChartLocusAffineLocal` reduces `haff` to — now rests on exactly one hypothesis:
`IsChartDatumPlusFibre`, a witness-free, `H¹`-free, divisor-free identity of plus classes at the
residue fields. -/
theorem isChartDatumPresentation_of_plusFibre_tower {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    {μ : picEt C (overSpec k A)} {D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C A π}
    (hfib : IsChartDatumPlusFibre C π μ D) :
    IsChartDatumPresentation C π μ D := by
  refine isChartDatumPresentation_of_plusFibre_of_converse C π hfib fun t hsplit => ?_
  refine hasWitnessH1Vanishing_of_isSplitWitness_tower C π μ D t
    (fun L _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => ?_) hsplit
  exact isChartDatumPlusFibreAt_of_isScalarTower C π μ D t L hfib

end

def chartLocusOpens (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (lam : picEt C T)
    (haff : ∀ U : T.left.affineOpens,
      IsOpen (chartLocus C m Z (picEtMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) lam))) :
    T.left.Opens where
  carrier := chartLocus C m Z lam
  is_open' := isOpen_chartLocus_of_affineLocal' C m Z T lam haff

@[simp]
lemma mem_chartLocusOpens {m : ℕ} {Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor}
    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {lam : picEt C T}
    {haff : ∀ U : T.left.affineOpens,
      IsOpen (chartLocus C m Z (picEtMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) lam))}
    {t : T.left} :
    t ∈ chartLocusOpens C m Z T lam haff ↔ t ∈ chartLocus C m Z lam :=
  Iff.rfl
